Registered voters prefer Democratic candidates for Congress to Republican candidates by a 6-point margin (46% vs. 40%), according to this week's Economist / YouGov Poll. Democrats lead by more among likely voters, according to both of YouGov's two definitions of them: [...] All three margins are in line with Economist / YouGov Polls in recent weeks.

Democrats' 11-point lead among likely voters according to the strict screen is bigger than the 6-point lead Democrats held at this stage of the 2018 election among the equivalent group; the poll question then didn't name candidates. In 2018, Democrats won the national popular vote by 9 points and won 235 seats in the House.
